name: VorpX
summary: Commercial VR injector with curated profiles for hundreds of games. Offers two core rendering modes: Geometry 3D (Dual-View Rendering via driver hooks) and Z-Normal (Single-View Depth Reprojection via depth buffer). Also supports Cinema mode for flat-screen VR. SBS output is available as a side-effect of VR mode.
compatibility_notes: Paid (~€40 one-time). Performance overhead vs native. Next-gen game updates can break profiles. Z-Normal mode has depth artifacts typical of depth reprojection.
